description: List notes, optionally scoped to an entity or filtered by full text and creation date. Folk REST: GET /v1/notes.

created_after.description: Only notes created after this ISO 8601 timestamp — maps to query createdAfter.

created_before.description: Only notes created before this ISO 8601 timestamp — maps to query createdBefore.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor — pass the value from a previous page's pagination.nextLink to fetch the next page.

entity_id.description: Restrict to notes on this entity (person/company) id — maps to query key entity.id.

name: folk_list_notes
title: List notes
